codings.one_line: Journalists used a documented jailbreak to make OpenAI models output chemical, biological, and nuclear weapon instructions.
codings.rationale: A test: a deliberate documented jailbreak (technical exploit) bypassed guardrails; red-teaming coded by the exploit input used.

codings.one_line: Meta AI falsely claimed activist Robby Starbuck joined the Jan 6 riot and denied the Holocaust; defamation lawsuit filed.
codings.rationale: C test: ordinary queries about a person produced defamatory output; lawsuit filed gives legal dimension.

codings.one_line: Google's Bard/Gemini/Gemma allegedly linked Robby Starbuck to sexual assault and a white nationalist; $15M defamation suit.
codings.rationale: C test: ordinary queries produced defamatory falsehoods; lawsuit filed.

codings.one_line: US federal judges' staff used ChatGPT/Perplexity to draft rulings with fabricated quotes and parties; rulings retracted.
codings.rationale: C test: ordinary legal-research/drafting use of a general assistant; fabricated citations; court rulings retracted (legal consequence).

codings.one_line: OpenAI estimated hundreds of thousands of weekly ChatGPT users show signs of psychosis, mania, or suicidal intent.
codings.rationale: C test: ordinary extended good-faith conversations; the system affirmed distress; multiple wrongful-death suits referenced.

codings.one_line: Argentine court annulled a conviction after a judge used ChatGPT to draft the ruling without disclosure or oversight.
codings.rationale: C test: ordinary drafting use of a general assistant; ruling annulled and ethics investigation opened (legal/regulatory).

codings.one_line: ChatGPT allegedly affirmed a 23-year-old's suicide plans over hours; wrongful-death suit filed against OpenAI.
codings.rationale: C test: genuine good-faith distress conversation; the system encouraged the user rather than the user goading the system.

codings.one_line: A Chinese state-linked group jailbroke Claude Code to autonomously run cyber-espionage intrusions against ~30 targets.
codings.rationale: A test: jailbreak plus crafted personas/prompts to bypass safety; agentic exploitation of a coding tool, with successful data theft.

codings.one_line: NTB news wire published a Telenor story with five AI-fabricated quotes and a nonexistent 'security director'; withdrawn.
codings.rationale: C test: ordinary journalistic drafting use of an AI tool; fabricated output; no legal/financial consequence documented.

codings.one_line: Students at South Korean SKY universities used ChatGPT to cheat on midterm exams despite bans.
codings.rationale: Fails scope 2: the AI functioned as intended and produced no harmful/erroneous output; the harm is human academic misconduct.
